name: errands/music-shop-checkout
description: Planned by Opus as ONE script: play La Serenissima, fill the Migros basket (Jev picks each product), send the exact list to 'Message yourself', wait for the person's 'buy', check out (delivery 19:00+, saved card), and relay the bank's SMS code. 'cancel' in the chat ends it 3 s later.

steps.note: Search terms, not products: Jev chooses WHICH result is the ordinary version of each.
Nescafe x6. One iteration so a failed add skips its five '+' - they would otherwise press the '+' of whatever was clicked before.

with.goal: a single Nescafe Xpress Vanilya (vanilla iced coffee) 250 ml can
with.reject: multipacks like 3 x 250 ml, other flavours, other brands

with.goal: an ordinary loaf of everyday white bread (somun / sofra ekmeği)
with.reject: toast bread, baguettes, sourdough, whole-wheat, gluten-free, lavash, bazlama

steps.note: 'Some gofrets' = three of one ordinary chocolate wafer.

with.goal: an ordinary single chocolate wafer (çikolatalı gofret) snack bar
with.reject: multipacks, boxes, gift sets, diet or protein versions

steps.note: The EXACT products that verifiably went in, with quantities - from the runner's tally, not from the search terms.

with.message: Sepet hazir. Odemeye gecmem icin bu sohbete b-u-y yaz. Durdurmak icin c-a-n-c-e-l.

steps.note: Spelled with hyphens so this run's OWN message can never be counted as the person's answer.
The go-ahead. Only a NEW 'buy' counts; it unlocks the commit guard for checkout.

with.message: Tamam - teslimat 19:00 sonrasi, kayitli kart ile odemeye geciyorum.

steps.goal: On the Migros checkout: keep the delivery address that is already selected, and choose a DELIVERY TIME SLOT that starts at 19:00 or later (the earliest such slot that is available, today if possible). Then continue to the payment step. Done when the payment step (card choice) is on screen.

On the Migros payment step: choose the SAVED card that is already on the account (do not type any card numbers), tick any required agreement / contract checkbox, and press the final order / payment button. Done when the page asks for an SMS / 3-D Secure verification code, OR shows that the order was placed.

with.message: Banka SMS kodu istiyor - kodu buraya yaz. Durdurmak icin c-a-n-c-e-l.

then.goal: Switch to the browser tab with the bank's SMS / 3-D Secure verification page (NOT WhatsApp - use ctrl+shift+a tab search if needed), type the code {code} into its code field and submit it. Done when the page has moved past verification.

with.message: Odeme adimi SMS istemeden bitti - Migros'ta siparisi kontrol et.

steps.note: Hold until the person closes it; 'cancel' ends the run 3 s later.
